name: replace_with_sensor_name
description: Template for product-specific image-sensor stack parameters. Fill this with measured or process-deck values.

calibration_status.note: Set is_measured=true and geometry_measured=true only after geometry and every material n,k file are target-sensor measured.

shield.notes: Keep off for normal imaging pixels. Enable pdaf_left, pdaf_right, pdaf_pair, or edge only for measured PDAF/aperture-mask variants.

silicon.source: Replace with target wafer temperature/doping model if needed.

passivation.source: Measured effective dielectric / AR stack n,k.

metal.source: Replace with validated metal model only after numerical-stability checks.
metal.usage: optional PDAF/aperture mask only; not present when shield.mode is off

accuracy_notes: Do not use this template until every measured file path exists.
For quantitative camera simulation, verify geometry, material data, convergence, and optical-to-electrical collection separately.
